tagline: Schedule project kickoffs from Asana milestones and post call summaries to tasks
metaTitle: Asana + Zoom Integration: Kickoff Calls and Summaries
metaDescription: Kick off projects without scheduling by hand. GAIA books a Zoom call when an Asana project starts and posts the summary to it. See the setup steps.
intro:
Project milestones in Asana often trigger the need for a team meeting — a kickoff call when a project launches, a review meeting when a phase completes, or a retrospective when a milestone is missed. Scheduling these meetings manually, then copying action items from the Zoom call back into the project by hand, creates friction and delays that compound across every project.

GAIA connects Asana and Zoom so project events automatically trigger the right meetings and meeting outcomes automatically flow back into project tasks. When a milestone is reached, GAIA schedules the appropriate call and invites the right participants. When the call ends, GAIA posts the meeting summary and extracts action items as new tasks, keeping your project moving without manual follow-up.

This integration is valuable for project managers who run recurring milestone reviews and for teams that rely on video calls for collaboration but need meeting outcomes to live inside the project, where work actually gets tracked.

useCases.title: Auto-schedule kickoff calls from project creation
useCases.description: When a new project is created, GAIA schedules a kickoff call with all project members, sends calendar invites, and attaches the meeting link to the project for easy access.

useCases.title: Trigger milestone review meetings automatically
useCases.description: When a milestone is marked complete, GAIA schedules a review meeting with the relevant stakeholders within a configurable window, ensuring reviews happen promptly without manual scheduling.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Asana tasks
useCases.description: After a call linked to a project, GAIA generates a meeting summary and posts it as a comment on the relevant task or project, creating a permanent record of what was discussed.

useCases.title: Create Asana tasks from Zoom action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes meeting transcripts for action items and automatically creates corresponding tasks with assignees, descriptions, and due dates derived from what was agreed during the call.

useCases.title: Overdue project escalation calls
useCases.description: When a project is overdue by a configurable threshold, GAIA automatically schedules an urgent call with the project manager and key stakeholders to diagnose and resolve the delay.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your workspace and your meeting account. Link your calendar so GAIA can schedule meetings at times that work for all participants.
Define which milestones or project events should trigger meetings, who should be invited, and how soon after the milestone the meeting should be scheduled.

howItWorks.step: GAIA schedules meetings and captures outcomes
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the workspace for milestone events, schedules the appropriate calls, and after each meeting posts summaries and action items back to the project automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule Zoom calls from Asana task comments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention GAIA in a task comment and ask it to schedule a meeting for the task assignees. GAIA checks availability and sends calendar invites with the meeting link.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require transcription to be enabled for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meeting summaries rely on the transcription feature being enabled for the call. GAIA accesses the transcript after the meeting ends and generates a structured summary posted to the relevant task.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create recurring meetings for ongoing projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. For long-running projects, GAIA can schedule recurring standups or review meetings based on sprint cycles or project phase timelines, with participants updated as the team changes.
